title: Nonfreeness for rational two-parabolic groups with numerator 24: Lean formalization

creators.name: Wang, Ziheng
creators.affiliation: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou Institute for Advanced Study, Hangzhou, China

description: Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization accompanying the manuscript "Nonfreeness for rational two-parabolic groups with numerator 24" by Ziheng Wang. It proves nonfreeness in SL(2,Q) and SL(2,C) for every integer denominator r with |r| > 6, provides nontrivial reduced relations of at most 64 generator-power syllables, and proves the two-step triangular-word condition for |r| > 17. AI assistance: GPT-6-Astra. The software is licensed under MIT; the accompanying manuscript and its source/PDF under paper/ are licensed separately under CC BY 4.0. Verification status and precise scope are recorded in the included logs and verification-result.json. Source repository: https://github.com/wingsyuyi-satori/nonfree-G24r.
